summary: ### Name of the resource AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup ### Resource Name _No response_ ### Issue Description When creating a AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup resource with TargetType set to Lambda the HealthCheckEnabled defaults to false. This causes issues when updating the Target Group resource as CloudFormation performs a DescribeTargetHealth API call to mark the update as successful. This leads the resource to become stuck during an update as the health check is disabled. Enabling it manually causes the resource to update successfully. An update should be made to ensure
title: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup - Lambda target update without healthcheck
